specs.title: Add a product to the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the product list
2. Click `Add to Basket` on the product
3. Open the basket with the button `Your Basket`
4. Read the total of the basket

specs.title: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

steps.title: 1. Open the basket
2. Click the plus button in the row of product A
3. Click the minus button in the row of product A
4. Click the minus button in the row of product A again
5. Click the trash button in the row of product A
1. Open the product list and click `Add to Basket` on the product
2. Open the basket and click plus until the quantity is 5
3. Click the plus button one more time
4. Read the basket
5. Open the product list and click `Add to Basket` on the product

specs.title: Login with a valid and an invalid password

steps.title: Precondition: create a customer account, nobody is logged in
1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the email and the wrong password
3. Open the account menu
4. Close the menu and log in with the correct password
5. Open the account menu
